jobs_results.title: Senior Data DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
DESCRIPTION

Do you have a systems engineering background and strong knowledge in Data DevOps? Are you an open-minded professional with good English skills? If it sounds like you, this could be the perfect opportunity to join EPAM as a Senior Data DevOps Engineer.

Our teams work in highly agile working environments for Fortune 1000 clients, following XP practices and best CI/CD practices. We are looking for a Senior Data DevOps Engineer with open-minded personality, who can join our friendly environment and become a core contributor to our team of experts.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
• Building and deploying of R packages
• Installation, upgrade and patching of R Studio Workbench, Connect and Package Manager, including upgrading R Bundle
• Change Management process will be followed for the package deployment
• One release/change every 2 months
• Client will be ensuring the availability of SO, QA and Business teams to provide the required support as per the timelines of expedited release
•... Rebuilding R
• Building Python package for nearly 600 packages
• Working on upgrades
• Image J, Non Mem, PSN, Python
• OpenShift, Mathematica, RStudio Workbench upgrade to latest version

WHAT YOU HAVE
• DevOps/SysAdmin engineer with knowledge and experience in Advanced linux concepts, Operating system concepts
• Experience in installation, upgrade and patching of R Studio Workbench, Connect and Package Manager
• R-Packages, Python packages, Easy Build, Python Programming
• R Studio (Workbench, Connect, Shiny) Admin, Linux, Shell Scripting
• OpenShift, GitLab, Docker
• Packages management

WE OFFER
• WORK & LIFE BALANCE. Enjoy more of your personal time with flexible & remote work options, 24 working days of annual leave and paid time off for numerous public holidays
• CONTINUOUS LEARNING CULTURE. Develop your hard & soft skills with internal training and mentorship opportunities, sponsored professional certification, and access to 18,000+ LinkedIn courses
• CLEAR & DIFFERENT CAREER PATHS. Grow in engineering or managerial direction to become a People Manager, in-depth technical specialist, Solution Architect, or Project/Delivery Manager
• GLOBAL RELOCATION OPPORTUNITIES. EPAM has presence in more than 50 countries globally. Explore opportunities to relocate to a new country, and EPAM will provide relocation support for you and your family
• COMPETITIVE BENEFITS. Benefit from a competitive salary, private health insurance, employee stock purchase plan, special discount programs, plus, internal wellbeing programs to take your career to the next level
• STRONG PROFESSIONAL COMMUNITY. Join a global EPAM community of highly skilled experts and connect with them to solve challenges, exchange ideas, share expertise and make friends

ABOUT EPAM
• EPAM is a leading digital transformation services and product engineering company with over 53,150 EPAMers in more than 55 countries and regions . Since 1993, our multidisciplinary teams have been helping make the future real for our clients and communities around the world. In 2018, we opened an office in Spain that quickly grew to over 1,450 EPAMers distributed between the offices in Málaga and Madrid as well as remotely across the country . Here you will collaborate with multinational teams, contribute to numerous innovative projects, and have an opportunity to learn and grow continuously

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Who we are

At Xceed we are all about unlocking the extraordinary. Our mission is to connect music lovers with authentic events and inspiring individuals, fostering unforgettable experiences that last well beyond the night's end.

Xceed is a venture-backed startup headquartered in Barcelona on a mission to create a world where everyone can live extraordinary experiences by joining authentic music events and connecting with inspiring people. We currently operate in over 20 markets globally and take 10 million unique event-goers out for a dance each month.

Recognized as the Apple Top 100 Apps in the world and fastest-growing start-up in Spain in 2018, our team is currently looking for a DevOps Engineer to join our team.

We’re here to have a good time and make epic things happen and won’t settle for anything less.

Who you are

As a DevOps Engineer at Xceed, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of our cloud-based SaaS platform. You will... work closely with our development and operations teams as a trusted advisor to automate processes, manage infrastructure, and implement best practices to support our rapid growth. (to review with the Storytelling)

What will you do
• Design, implement, and maintain automated infrastructure provisioning using tools such as Terraform.
• Build and manage CI/CD pipelines to facilitate seamless and efficient software releases (We're using Jenkins but we plan to move to Github Actions)
• Manage monitoring solutions (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana) and centralized logging to proactively identify and resolve issues.
• Ensure the security of our infrastructure by implementing best practices, performing regular security assessments, and staying up-to-date with security trends.
• Collaborate with the development team to scale our platform as needed to accommodate growing user demand.
• Develop and maintain disaster recovery plans and backup solutions to safeguard critical data and services.
• Identify and address performance bottlenecks through monitoring, tuning, and optimization.
• Maintain comprehensive documentation of infrastructure, configurations, and processes to facilitate knowledge sharing.
• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including developers and external providers, to ensure smooth software delivery.

What we are looking for
• Knowledge of security features on UNIX platforms especially appreciated
• Solid experience with Microservices architecture
• Design and implementation of Docker containers (Distributed systems with Docker like Kubernetes or ECS is a bonus)
• IaC (Terraform or similar)
• CI/CD with Jenkins or similar (Gitlab/ Bitbucket Pipelines)
• Knowledge of Ansible, Puppet or similar
• Strong experience with AWS (we practically use all of this platform)
• Monitoring systems (Cloudwatch, Prometheus)
• Web Servers (Nginx/NodeJS)
• Networks (VPC, Load Balancers, API gateways, DNS and proxy servers)
• DB servers (SQL or similar) and some basic DB knowledge
• Caching Servers (Redis)
• ElasticSearch/OpenSearch
• Centralized logging with ELK Stack
• Email Servers (SES)
• CDNs and asset management
• Queue services (SQS/SNS)
• Tuning and Performance Analysis
• Experience with PHP development environment

Our perks
• Competitive base salary according to your experience.
• Unlimited remote working and absolute flexibility.
• Unlimited holidays.
• Unlimited access to our learning platforms (Codely, PluralSight, MasterClass…) - you have a vast opportunity to learn and grow.
• Join team-building activities and meet-and-greet events.
• Fixed weekly hours allocated to studying, learning and personal development.

Why Xceed will be your favorite team?
• You will become part of a successful and growing start-up that has been quadrupling revenues year after year.
• You will form part of a passionate, hardworking, and ambitious team
• You will enjoy a casual, young, and multicultural mindset
• You will have full autonomy and vast opportunities to learn & grow
• You will thrive in an environment built to experiment with new ideas
• & you will absolutely, always, 100%, have lotssss of fun!

Our principles

Moderation is fatal

Taste everything

Have no plan B

Inspire

Don’t ask if the party is going to be fun

At Xceed we offer equal opportunities - all qualifying applications will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, your favorite football team or music taste - except reggaeton, we probably cannot accept that, sorry ;).

Xceed focuses on Music, Big Data, Nightlife, and Event Management. Their company has offices in Barcelona. They have a small team that's between 11-50 employees. To date, Xceed has raised $5.045M of funding; their latest round was closed on November 2022.

You can view their website at https://xceed.me or find them on Twitter, Facebook, and LinkedIn

jobs_results.title: Sr Cloud Infrastructure (DevOps)
jobs_results.description:
The Company:
You will get the opportunity to join a fast-growing company, modest enough for you to play a meaningful role and influence our technology and ways of working, but broad enough to make a change working towards long-term goals in an agile environment. The platform we build automates the insights-gathering process so that companies can gain access to insights faster with unparalleled scale.
You will be someone that shares our values and ambitions and can bring something to the team that we can benefit from. It might be a prior experience of the journey, architectural insight into cloud-native systems, specific technical expertise in parts of our stack or a combination of them all. Whatever it is, you will be the kind of person that is energized by complex challenges, teamwork and problem-solving.

Your Day-to-Day:
• Work as part of the infrastructure team on sprints that evolve our core platform and systems
• Provide point of expertise on infrastructure and CI/CD to our... wider engineering teams - often working as part of their scrum on larger projects
• Automate the build and deployment of software to our cloud platform and help the organization do it more efficiently and effectively. Eliminate all repetitive manual operations from our daily lives
• Improve our monitoring and alerting systems to enable engineering teams to successfully operate and gain insights into the behavior of applications in “hands-off” environments
• Participate in an on-call rotation and assist with troubleshooting issues that arise
• You will be a key person for the development organization by collecting and communicating the overall picture that will enable the teams to achieve better results

What you need:
• You have experience in predominantly cloud infrastructure roles (AWS) working within teams that practice DevOps
• You can interact comfortably with AWS via CLI and/or API
• You have expertise and solid experience in deploying infrastructure as code with, at minimum, Terraform and ideally some of the supporting cast (Ansible, Packer)
• You have excellent knowledge of building and running Docker images/containers
• You have excellent knowledge and understanding of the software development lifecycle, including the use of git and continuous integration tools (Jenkins’ Groovy DSL, TravisCI, github actions etc.)
• You have a grasp of “cloud native” and 12-Factor applications
• You have good knowledge of monitoring and alerting using one or more of: Graphite, Statsd, Prometheus, Grafana, PagerDuty
• You have expertise in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, Bash, Ruby, Node, Golang, Java)

Nice to haves:
• You have good knowledge of the network stack at L4 and L7, particularly inter-VPC routing
• You have some experience with managing DNS and resolver hierarchies
• You can debug HTTP APIs and understand other L7 protocols
• You have experience administering Kubernetes
• You have specific cloud security expertise (threat assessment, attack surface management, SGs, NACLs, data security)
• You have experience in building and running Windows servers in AWS
• You have experience with continuous deployment strategies and technologies (Blue/Green, DNS or LB weighting, automated regression testing, Spinnaker, CodeDeploy, Jenkins for CD)

Benefits:
• Advantage of working in a large, stable, and reliable company, which managed to keep a dynamic and friendly work environment.
• Experience in international projects for first-rate global companies.
• Attractive salary and compensation package (advanced health insurance, dental, gym, ticket restaurant etc.)
• Company-sponsored professional training and certifications.
• Career growth and opportunities for development

jobs_results.title: DevOps Lead Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Mid-senior level Leuven, Belgium,Barcelona, Spain,Kyiv, Ukraine Hybrid Full-time Software Engineering & Research
DevOps Lead Engineer

BARCELONA, SPAIN

KYIV, UKRAINE

SOFTWARE ENGINEERING & RESEARCH

HYBRID

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced DevOps Lead Engineer to lead our DevOps team and drive the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of our DevOps practices. As a key member of our technology leadership team, the DevOps Lead Engineer will play a crucial role in enhancing our software development lifecycle, ensuring seamless collaboration between development and operations teams, and optimizing our infrastructure for efficiency and scalability.
• Provide strategic leadership in the design and implementation of DevOps processes and practices
• Collaborate with executive leadership to align DevOps initiatives with overall business objectives
• Develop and communicate a clear vision for the DevOps team and its contributions to the organization
• Lead and... mentor a team of DevOps engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement
• Set performance expectations, conduct regular performance reviews, and support professional development
• Design and implement robust, scalable, and secure DevOps solutions that meet current and future organizational needs
• Oversee the integration of automation tools and technologies to streamline development and deployment processes
• Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines to facilitate rapid and reliable delivery of software
• Ensure the automation of testing, deployment, and monitoring processes to minimize manual intervention
• Optimize cloud and on-premises infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness
• Implement and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) practices to enable consistent and repeatable infrastructure deployments
• Establish and maintain monitoring and alerting systems to ensure the health and performance of applications and infrastructure
• Develop incident response plans and lead the response to critical incidents, minimizing downtime and impact on users
Your profile
• Bachelor's or an advanced degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field
• Proven experience (5 years) in a DevOps leadership role with a track record of successful implementation of DevOps practices
• Expertise in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
• Strong background in scripting and automation (e.g., Python, Shell, Ansible)
• In-depth knowledge of CI/CD concepts and tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitLab CI)
• Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform) and configuration management tools
• Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for driving innovation through DevOps practices, we invite you to apply and contribute to the success of our organization. Join us in shaping the future of our technology landscape!
Location and type of contract
• Full-time
• Hybrid
• Mid-senior level

Share on:

Materialise’s mission is to innovate for a better and healthier world through its software and hardware infrastructure and in-depth knowledge of additive manufacturing (also known as 3D printing). Our customers are in diverse industries, such as automotive, aerospace, medical, research, and academia.

As a growing company, Materialise is always looking for enthusiastic professionals who want to work in an environment full of revolutionary technology and surrounded by people passionate about their work.

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer Senior (AI Tribe)
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

At T-Systems, you will find groundbreaking projects that contribute to social and ecological well-being. We want to welcome new talents like you, who bring fresh ideas, different perspectives, embrace challenges, and are committed to continuous learning in order to grow and make an impact on society... all in a fun way!

It doesn't matter when or where you work. It's about doing meaningful work that advances society. For this reason, we will do everything possible to ensure that you have all the development opportunities by providing a support network, excellent technology, a new work environment, and the freedom to work autonomously. We support you in growing both personally and professionally so that you can make a notable impact on society.

T-Systems is a team of around 28,000 employees worldwide, making us one of the leading global providers of end-to-end integrated solutions. We develop hybrid cloud solutions, artificial intelligence, and drive the digital... transformation of companies, industries, the public sector, and ultimately, society as a whole.

Job Description

AI Tribe at T-Systems is seeking a seasoned DevOps and Cloud Platform Expert to play a crucial role in deploying and maintaining our AI-driven solutions.

Responsibilities:
• Design and implement CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI/CD for smooth software delivery
• Develop, deploy, and manage applications on Kubernetes clusters, ensuring scalability and reliability
• Optimize cloud infrastructure on platforms like GCP, Azure, or other cloud providers
• Collaborate with development teams to automate testing processes and enhance test coverage
• Monitor and troubleshoot infrastructure, responding to incidents and ensuring high availability
• Continuously improve deployment strategies, performance, and efficiency
• Stay updated on emerging DevOps trends and cloud technologies, applying them to enhance processes.

Join AI Tribe at T-Systems and contribute to the seamless deployment and maintenance of AI solutions using cutting-edge DevOps practices.

We offer a collaborative environment, professional growth opportunities and the chance to work on impactful projects.

To apply, submit your resume in English.

Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
• Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containerization, and orchestration
• Proficiency in setting up and maintaining cloud infrastructure on GCP, Azure, OTC or similar platforms
• Strong knowledge of GitLab CI/CD, GitLab pipelines, and version control.
• Experience with test automation frameworks and practices
• Solid scripting skills (Python, Bash, etc.) for automating tasks and building tools
• Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and optimize system performance
• Excellent communication skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Nice to Have:
• Certification in Kubernetes (CKA), GCP, Azure, or other relevant cloud platforms
• Experience with MLOps solutions such as Kubeflow or MLFlow
• Programming skills in Go, Python and experience with Kubernetes Operator development
• Familiarity with AI and ML concepts
• Exposure to infrastructure as code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible.

Additional Information

What do we offer you?
• International, positive, dynamic, and motivated work environment
• Hybrid work model (telework/face-to-face)
• Flexible schedule
• Continuous training
• Flexible Compensation Plan
• Life and accident insurance
• More than 25 working days of vacation per year.

And many more advantages of being part of T-Systems!

If you are looking for a new challenge, do not hesitate to send us your CV! Please send CV in English. Join our team!

T-Systems Iberia will only process the CVs of candidates who meet the requirements specified for each offer

For this reason, we will do everything possible to ensure that you have all the development opportunities by providing a support network, excellent technology, a new work environment, and the freedom to work autonomously. We support you in growing both personally and professionally so that you can make a notable impact on society.

T-Systems is a team of around 28,000 employees worldwide, making us one of the leading global providers of end-to-end integrated solutions. We develop hybrid cloud solutions, artificial intelligence, and drive the digital... transformation of companies, industries, the public sector, and ultimately, society as a whole.

Job Description

AI Tribe at T-Systems is seeking a seasoned DevOps and Cloud Platform Expert to play a crucial role in deploying and maintaining our AI-driven solutions.

Responsibilities:
• Design and implement CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI/CD for smooth software delivery
• Develop, deploy, and manage applications on Kubernetes clusters, ensuring scalability and reliability
• Optimize cloud infrastructure on platforms like GCP, Azure, or other cloud providers
• Collaborate with development teams to automate testing processes and enhance test coverage
• Monitor and troubleshoot infrastructure, responding to incidents and ensuring high availability
• Continuously improve deployment strategies, performance, and efficiency
• Stay updated on emerging DevOps trends and cloud technologies, applying them to enhance processes.

Join AI Tribe at T-Systems and contribute to the seamless deployment and maintenance of AI solutions using cutting-edge DevOps practices.

We offer a collaborative environment, professional growth opportunities and the chance to work on impactful projects.

To apply, submit your resume in English.

Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
• Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containerization, and orchestration
• Proficiency in setting up and maintaining cloud infrastructure on GCP, Azure, OTC or similar platforms
• Strong knowledge of GitLab CI/CD, GitLab pipelines, and version control.
• Experience with test automation frameworks and practices
• Solid scripting skills (Python, Bash, etc.) for automating tasks and building tools
• Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and optimize system performance
• Excellent communication skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Nice to Have:
• Certification in Kubernetes (CKA), GCP, Azure, or other relevant cloud platforms
• Experience with MLOps solutions such as Kubeflow or MLFlow
• Programming skills in Go, Python and experience with Kubernetes Operator development
• Familiarity with AI and ML concepts
• Exposure to infrastructure as code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible.

Additional Information

What do we offer you?
• International, positive, dynamic, and motivated work environment
• Hybrid work model (telework/face-to-face)
• Flexible schedule
• Continuous training
• Flexible Compensation Plan
• Life and accident insurance
• More than 25 working days of vacation per year.

And many more advantages of being part of T-Systems!

If you are looking for a new challenge, do not hesitate to send us your CV! Please send CV in English. Join our team!

T-Systems Iberia will only process the CVs of candidates who meet the requirements specified for each offer

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey in Contextual Decision Intelligence?

If you're passionate about enabling individuals and organisations to make informed decisions most efficiently, we have an exceptional opportunity for you!

Our trailblazing client is spearheading a new era of meaningful data. Their breakthrough software connects internal and external data, revealing unseen relationships. This powers cutting-edge AI tackling critical challenges in risk, fraud, AML, and beyond.

Partnering with elite global banks, insurers, and tech giants, our client is revolutionising decision intelligence. Come shape the future at this fast-rising analytics disruptor. Step into the realm of data analysis redefined.

What You'll Dive Into:

In this role, you’ll enhance platform availability, resilience, usability and security, while reducing operational burden. Staying at the forefront of cloud tech, you’ll create new integrated offerings for customers to leverage.

Using leading... DevOps techniques, you’ll collaborate with top engineers to support software releases. This is a premier opportunity to showcase your skills on an industry-leading platform enabling groundbreaking AI. Immerse yourself in their acclaimed cloud landscape that’s redefining what’s possible with data and analytics.

Key Achievements:

Join a team of over 500 talented professionals. Become part of an organisation with a valuation exceeding $900 million. Proud recipient of the Google Cloud 2020 Industry Solutions Partner of the Year award.

Their Technology Stack:
• A strong focus on Docker/Kubernetes/Istio
• DevOps tooling/automation written with Bash/Python/Groovy/Jenkins/Golang
• Provisioning software/frameworks (Elasticsearch/Spark/Hadoop/PostgreSQL)
• Infrastructure Management - CasC, IasC (Ansible, Terraform, Packer)
• Log and metric aggregation with Fluentd, Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager
• Public Cloud, primarily GCP, but also AWS and Azure

We seek developers and engineers who:
• Relish designing and delivering high-quality solutions to complex problems. You see the big picture.
• Have in-depth experience with cloud and DevOps tech like Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS.
• Know how to build robust and secure systems end-to-end.
• Have scripting/programming chops and a passion for automation.
• Love managing infrastructure and leveraging Linux.
• Take pride in your work and hold yourself to high standards.

Their acclaimed platform is waiting for your engineering skills to help enhance and scale its capabilities. Bring your expertise in cloud, DevOps and infrastructure to propel innovation in AI and data analytics. Help them redefine what’s possible

jobs_results.title: Cloud and DevOps Engineer - Biologics Discovery Platform
jobs_results.description:
Are you ready to make a meaningful impact on people's lives with life-changing
medicines? At AstraZeneca, we're not just about creating life-changing
medicines; we're about creating a culture of innovation and collaboration. We
are building the Biologics Discovery Platform within R&D IT to revolutionize
antibody discovery. We're looking for a Cloud and DevOps Engineer who can
build and maintain secure, efficient, and scalable cloud data and compute
infrastructure for biologics discovery together with the engineering team. If
you're someone who can work collaboratively with the engineering team on
cutting edge software and cloud technologies, then this is the role for you!

_Accountabilities:_

As a Cloud and DevOps Engineer, you will join a global team of engineers
(software, data, MLOps), architects, BAs, PMs, in our Biologics Discovery
Platform to support biologics and antibody drug discovery. You will be
responsible for creating secure, scalable, and cost-efficient... cloud
infrastructure for application development, deploying and maintaining self-
serve engineering platform tools and applications for CI/CD, observability,
security, etc., monitoring the cloud costs and usage pattern to optimise costs
and CO2 footprint of our applications, aligning with the central cloud
security team to ensure that our infrastructure satisfies enterprise security
standards, working with development teams to improve performance of the
applications, updating infrastructure regularly with zero or little downtime,
building standardised CI/CD shared pipelines that can be used across multiple
projects, implementing monitoring of the infrastructure and continuously
improving availability.

_Essential Skills/Experience:_

• In depth experience with setup, configuration, and maintenance of Cloud services.

• Experience with automated deployment tools and the principles of CI/CD using tools such as (but not limited to) Jenkins, CloudFormation, CDK, Ansible, Helm etc.

• Good understanding of containerization and orchestration (K8S experience preferable)

• Experience in cloud design

• Experience in system maintenance, recovery and administration across Linux and Windows

• Basic understanding of database systems (Relational/NoSQL).

• Experienced user of Git with understanding of branching and Git flows

• Good knowledge of IT Security, particularly, how it pertains to running services in the Cloud.

• Scripting experience in Python, Bash or similar.

• Knowledge & experience of Enterprise Identity Management (e.g., SSO, SAML, OpenID Connect).

• Solid understand of application architectures including Cloud Native approaches to infrastructure.

• Exposure or have worked as a DevOps/SRE/Cloud Engineer in the past

• Experience in creating and maintain managed cloud services (virtual machines, Kubernetes clusters, File systems, Object stores, databases, etc.)

• Experience working on one of the major cloud platforms

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with
the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the
platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That’s
why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But
that doesn't mean we’re not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in
the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and
ambitious world.

Why AstraZeneca:

At AstraZeneca, we are driven by our commitment to deliver accelerated growth and to make people's lives better. We thrive in our often intense and ambiguous environment, seeking out new challenges and working towards new solutions. A place where anyone is supported to step up and lead, and everyone has the freedom to take ownership and drive outcomes forward. We are part of an inclusive and giving community, we support and help each other on our journeys. backed by the same personal commitment to each other as we give to patients. Curious problem-solvers, we are intellectually stimulated by constant learning. There's potential for multiple, global careers and great rewards, for those who embrace the diverse opportunities.

Are you ready to make a positive impact? Join us at AstraZeneca where we are
turning molecules into medicines, bringing our Research & Development pipeline
to life through a rigorous process of development, manufacturing, testing and
delivery. Apply now!
• *Date Posted**

16-abr-2024
• *Closing Date**

29-abr-2024

AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed
to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with
as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading
skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will
be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified
candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all
applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and
recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility
verification requirements

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
What is nazaríes intelligenia?

nazaríes intelligenia is a Spanish company focused on the development and service of software products. Its three lines of business help our clients to have a long term technological partner.

From the engineering division we improve and develop the software products used by thousands of people, from the customer success division we accompany the clients who must use these products, which includes the implementation of solutions, translation and technical support, and with all this knowledge we develop the third division, which consists of our own product on industry 4.0 to capture, store, work and visualize the data of any physical device, mainly focused on the industrial world and with special emphasis on the agro-industry.

Who are we looking for?

The product quality, the customer satisfaction and our team’s professionalism make the difference. With the aim to deliver our highly visible projects, we are looking for smart, collaborative, enthusiastic... and well-organized professionals who are willing to take an active part in a sustainable, long-term product venture with a start-up mindset. We are looking for a DevOps Engineer.

Role Overview:

The DevOps Engineer plays a crucial role in bridging the gap between development, quality assurance, and IT operations. They are responsible for streamlining the software delivery process, ensuring the efficiency, reliability, and scalability of systems while fostering a culture of collaboration between different teams.

Key Responsibilities:
• Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD): Implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines to automate the build, test, and deployment processes.
• Infrastructure Automation: Developing and managing infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Terraform, Ansible, or Chef to automate provisioning, configuration, and deployment of infrastructure resources.
• Monitoring and Logging: Setting up monitoring tools and establishing logging practices to ensure system stability, performance optimization, and proactive issue identification.
• Cloud Services Management: Working with cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) to deploy and manage cloud-based infrastructure, optimizing costs and ensuring scalability.
• Collaboration and Communication: Facilitating communication between development, operations, and other teams, promoting a collaborative DevOps culture.
• Security Practices: Implementing security best practices throughout the development and deployment processes, ensuring compliance and security of systems.
• Scripting and Tool Development: Writing scripts and developing tools to automate manual processes and improve system efficiency.

Skills and Qualifications:
• Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, Bash, etc.) and automation tools.
• Experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or CircleCI.
• Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
• Knowledge of IaC tools like Terraform, Ansible, or Chef.
• Understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and their services.
• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
• Experience with monitoring tools like Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, etc.
• Knowledge of security best practices and compliance standards.

What we offer

✔A professional and multicultural working environment with people from all over the world.

✔An organized structure, product of years of experience in the industry, which allows all agents to benefit from our expertise.

✔All the required software, tools and database.

✔A fixed contract focused on a long-term relationship.

✔Health Insurance

✔24 days of vacation + December 24th and 31th.

✔Restaurant tickets.

✔Online training financed from 50% to 100% (Languages, AWS, Oracle, Azure, Languages)

🍷 Last but not least, team drinks a few times a month

From the engineering division we improve and develop the software products used by thousands of people, from the customer success division we accompany the clients who must use these products, which includes the implementation of solutions, translation and technical support, and with all this knowledge we develop the third division, which consists of our own product on industry 4.0 to capture, store, work and visualize the data of any physical device, mainly focused on the industrial world and with special emphasis on the agro-industry.

Who are we looking for?

The product quality, the customer satisfaction and our team’s professionalism make the difference. With the aim to deliver our highly visible projects, we are looking for smart, collaborative, enthusiastic... and well-organized professionals who are willing to take an active part in a sustainable, long-term product venture with a start-up mindset. We are looking for a DevOps Engineer.

Role Overview:

The DevOps Engineer plays a crucial role in bridging the gap between development, quality assurance, and IT operations. They are responsible for streamlining the software delivery process, ensuring the efficiency, reliability, and scalability of systems while fostering a culture of collaboration between different teams.

Key Responsibilities:
• Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD): Implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines to automate the build, test, and deployment processes.
• Infrastructure Automation: Developing and managing infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Terraform, Ansible, or Chef to automate provisioning, configuration, and deployment of infrastructure resources.
• Monitoring and Logging: Setting up monitoring tools and establishing logging practices to ensure system stability, performance optimization, and proactive issue identification.
• Cloud Services Management: Working with cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) to deploy and manage cloud-based infrastructure, optimizing costs and ensuring scalability.
• Collaboration and Communication: Facilitating communication between development, operations, and other teams, promoting a collaborative DevOps culture.
• Security Practices: Implementing security best practices throughout the development and deployment processes, ensuring compliance and security of systems.
• Scripting and Tool Development: Writing scripts and developing tools to automate manual processes and improve system efficiency.

Skills and Qualifications:
• Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, Bash, etc.) and automation tools.
• Experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or CircleCI.
• Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
• Knowledge of IaC tools like Terraform, Ansible, or Chef.
• Understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and their services.
• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
• Experience with monitoring tools like Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, etc.
• Knowledge of security best practices and compliance standards.
